title: ARS Ingest Agent — Output (successAssetManifest | errorEnvelope)
description: Validates the polymorphic v1.0 output of the Ingest Agent (Agent #8 of 17 — first post-production agent, 8th defense-in-depth firewall pass on the asset-layer surface, mode-convergence seam). Authored Day 54 (Fri Jun 12 2026) from SPEC §3 Outputs (Day 48 outline) + §6 8-code/slot-11 errorEnvelope (Day 51 §6.3 LOCKED) + §10 Field Map 25 rows + §10.4 schema authoring note (Day 51) + §12 deterministic AND-of-8-gates verdict math (Day 52) + §16 metadata block (Day 52). Polymorphism via top-level oneOf (mirrors AI Video Gen Day 14 + Style Replication Day 33 + QC Pre-flight Day 45 pattern). successAssetManifest <=> verdict 'pass'; errorEnvelope <=> verdict in {fail, reshoot}. DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE from QC Pre-flight: NO 'hold' verdict (§6.4 / Decision #3 — Ingest's domain is deterministic: a file is present or absent; there is no asset-layer ambiguity for a human to adjudicate mid-verdict; human deferral lives in human_review_required:true on EVERY emission, not in a verdict value). 8 LOCKED failure codes + slot-11 catch-all ingest_agent_failed enumerated via enum; the folded code duration_envelope_breach is NOT enumerated (subsumed into asset_spec_violation per Decision #14). The success branch encodes the §12 AND-of-8-gates as const invariants (firewall hits==0, URI non_relative==0 & dangling==0, all spec_check booleans true, missing_shots==[], coverage_complete==true) — making a false-pass STRUCTURALLY impossible (false-pass tolerance ZERO, Decision #10). byte_probe_performed const false (Decision #1/#11 — declared-spec-only honesty contract; flips to plain boolean in v1.1). manifest_evidence_hash pattern ^[a-f0-9]{64}$. asset_uri ^ars:// platform-relative (Hard Rule #8). human_review_required const true on EVERY branch (recommend-don't-clear — Decision #12). DOUBLY-DEFERRED (Decision D6): parent_chain held additively (minItems 5, prefixItems 0-6, maxItems 7, items false) — accepts the 5-tuple, the 6-tuple QC extension preview, AND the 7-tuple Ingest append. TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 7 (exact-7) ONLY after the Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs. The 7-tuple is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run.

successAssetManifest.description: verdict='pass' branch (§3.1). Emitted ONLY when all 8 AND-of-gate terms are true (§12 deterministic AND-of-gates, zero tunable thresholds): QC precondition met AND all URIs integral (non_relative==0 AND dangling==0) AND firewall clean (hits==0) AND all declared specs match AND full coverage (coverage_complete==true, missing_shots==[]) AND audio adjudicated AND lineage intact. The gate terms are schema-pinned as consts below, so a false-pass (a clean envelope alongside a failing sub-status) is STRUCTURALLY impossible (Decision #10 — false-pass tolerance ZERO). A reel with any defect routes to the errorEnvelope branch. human_review_required is const true even on pass (a pass = 'ready for the operator's clear-to-edit decision', NEVER 'cleared' — Decision #12 / Hard Rule #12).

asset_bundle.description: §10 bundle-normalization rows (the mode-convergence map). The editor's canonical pull list — three production source shapes (Mode A footage_upload_manifest / Mode B+C replicated_shots) normalized into ONE shape (Check #9). This block is byte-shape-identical regardless of ingested mode (the TC-01/TC-02 convergence proof).

raw_footage.description: Normalized per-shot footage rows {shot_ref, asset_uri, duration_sec, source}. source = the producing agent (style-replication-agent / ai-video-gen-agent) or videographer_upload (Mode A).

audio.description: Flat normalized audio URI list. Sync adjudication evidence lives in spec_check, not here.

assets_pulled.description: Brand-asset filename list (logo, lower-third templates) — firewall-confirmed (Check #4), not fetched.

mode_convergence.description: §10 convergence record (Check #9). Every field downstream of this block is mode-identical. The contract that makes Edit Director + all 9 downstream agents mode-blind (Decision #9 / Blueprint §3).

qc_precondition_check.description: §10 precondition evidence (Check #1). On a pass: verdict_observed=='pass' OR lever3_signoff_present==true (the only bypass, Decision #4).

allOf.description: Precondition gate (Decision #4): on the success branch the upstream verdict was 'pass' OR a Lever-3 sign-off was attached. A non-pass with no sign-off cannot reach this branch (it halts upstream_qc_not_passed).

asset_uri_integrity.description: §10 URI census (Check #3). non_relative==0 AND dangling==0 required on pass (gate term). uris_checked must equal the true bundle URI census.

asset_firewall_pass_8.description: §10 the 8th-pass firewall result on the asset-layer surface (Check #4) — filenames + embedded/sidecar metadata, a surface no prior content pass inspected. hits MUST be 0 on a pass; any hit => asset_firewall_breach (errorEnvelope branch).

spec_check.description: §10 Blueprint §4.8 shape (Checks #5+#7+#8). All booleans true + missing_shots==[] required on pass (gate term). Derived from DECLARED metadata ONLY (byte_probe_performed:false — no decode). The duration-envelope result folds into this family (asset_spec_violation, subtype duration_envelope — Decision #14).

missing_shots.description: REQUIRED-on-success (§10.4) — its emptiness IS the coverage invariant, so it cannot be optional. const empty on pass; populated only on missing_shot_coverage (errorEnvelope).

coverage_check.description: §10 coverage census (Check #6). shots_required == storyboard_ref.total_shots; coverage_complete == (shots_covered == shots_required). Internal consistency enforced (no phantom coverage). coverage_complete const true on pass (gate term).

handoff_targets.description: §10 — non-empty only on pass. v1.0 logical target = edit-director-agent (Agent #9, not yet built). Physical destination is the Notion Asset Manifest DB holding store until Agent #9 LOCKs (Decision D15 PRELIMINARY — operator-pending); the LOGICAL handoff_targets value is unaffected.

cost_incurred_usd.description: This agent's own self-cost (~$0.00 — reasoning only; $0.00 engine + $0.00 probe structurally guaranteed). Generative engine spend + byte-probe spend are FORBIDDEN ($0 invariant, not a bounded budget — Hard Rule #2). Reported to 2dp per Cross-SPEC §3.9. No cost-ceiling authority (Hard Rule #10 — QC Pre-flight's jurisdiction).

errorEnvelope.description: verdict in {fail, reshoot} branch (§3.2). fail = fixable without re-shooting (route to the responsible upstream agent or re-upload). reshoot = Mode A live footage unusable, take-substitution ladder exhausted (route to production-coord-agent; Mode-A-exclusive per Decision #3). NO 'hold' (§6.4 divergence — Ingest's domain is deterministic). human_review_required const true on every branch (the agent RECOMMENDS the verdict, the operator clears — Decision #12).

failure_code.description: 8 LOCKED codes (Day 51 §6.3) + slot-11 catch-all ingest_agent_failed (Cross-SPEC §3.6). The folded code duration_envelope_breach is NOT enumerated (subsumed into asset_spec_violation, detail.subtype 'duration_envelope' — Decision #14). ingest_agent_failed accompanies attempts==2 (self-QC 2-strike exhaustion).

failed_check_id.description: Which §6 self-QC check produced the verdict (1..11 — the 11-check list, bipartite-covering the 8 codes + slot-11).

attempts.description: Self-QC 2-strike ceiling (§6 retry policy). attempts==2 accompanies ingest_agent_failed (slot-11). No third attempt.

route_back_to.description: §3.2 / §10.5 verdict<->route map. production-coord-agent on reshoot (Mode A only); style-replication-agent / ai-video-gen-agent on a B/C re-gen fail; re-upload on a Mode A fixable defect; null on slot-11 ingest_agent_failed (self-QC exhaustion — no upstream is at fault).

detail.description: Free-form failure context (the specific violation, affected_shot, recovery_path, upstream_failed_branch, the take-substitution-ladder attempt on a reshoot, the firewall hit asset names + upstream stage on a breach, asset_spec_violation subtype incl. 'duration_envelope', etc.). Advisory recovery_path is surfaced, NOT auto-executed (v1.0 routes; it does not conform — §10.2 reserved).

allOf.description: Decision #3 — reshoot is Mode-A-exclusive and routes to production-coord-agent. A reshoot verdict MUST carry route_back_to: production-coord-agent AND failure_code: missing_shot_coverage (the only verdict-routing-mode-dependent code; Mode A, ladder exhausted).
Slot-11 self-QC exhaustion: ingest_agent_failed accompanies attempts==2 and routes nowhere upstream (route_back_to null — no upstream agent is at fault for the agent's own self-QC failure).

normalizedFootageRow.description: §10 normalized footage row — one shape regardless of source mode (the convergence guarantee).

source.description: The producing source — an AI agent (B/C) or the videographer upload (Mode A).

take.description: OPTIONAL — present only for Mode A rows (the selected take after the substitution ladder).

reelRefFull.description: Full reel reference (§10 row) — the cross-record audit join keys. asset_manifest_id is this agent's emitted identity (= parent_chain[6]).

reelRefMinimal.description: Minimal reel reference on the errorEnvelope branch (§3.2) — at minimum the emitting agent's own identity.

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

assetManifestId.description: This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) — also appended at parent_chain[6] (the 7-tuple extension, held additively). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format.

qcPreFlagsEmitted.description: Ingest's own emitted predicates (§3.7 snake_case, >=4 — Check #11). e.g. asset_firewall_clean_pass_8, full_storyboard_coverage, all_uris_platform_relative, declared_specs_match_plan. Appended to the upstream union without modifying it (§10.3).

sessionId.description: Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

parentChainHeld.description: DOUBLY-DEFERRED (Decision D6 / §10.4 / §16 addition 1). The 7-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY: prefixItems positions 0-6 = [brief_id, script_id, storyboard_id, production_plan_id|rendered_shots_set_id, replication_set_id, preflight_report_id, asset_manifest_id]. minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple inbound canon (pre-ratification); maxItems 7 ACCEPTS the 6-tuple QC extension preview AND the 7-tuple Ingest append; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. positions 0-5 inherit the QC Pre-flight parentChainHeld verbatim; position 6 is Ingest's append (asset_manifest_id, UUIDv7). TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 7 (exact-7) ONLY after BOTH gates close — the Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs. This is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (Ingest is the second forcing function for the amendment).

metadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block + 5 Ingest additions (§16): asset_manifest_class, manifest_evidence_hash, runtime_environment_class, byte_probe_performed (const false), asset_manifest_id. human_review_required const true (Decision #12). byte_probe_performed const false is the declared-spec honesty contract — a manifest CLAIMING probe-verified specs it never probed is forged provenance (Hard Rule #2).

latency_ms.description: Reasoning-only; target p50 <= 25000 / p95 <= 75000 (§8 performance portfolio).

asset_manifest_class.description: Addition 1. v1.0 = pre_edit; re_ingest reserved v1.1+ (§16).

manifest_evidence_hash.description: Addition 2. SHA-256 (lowercase hex, 64) over the per-asset evidence + spec_check block (§3.2). Tamper-evident manifest; the audit anchor.

runtime_environment_class.description: Addition 3. Inherited from AI Video Gen §16.

byte_probe_performed.description: Addition 4. const false in v1.0 — the declared-spec honesty contract (Decision #1/#11 / Hard Rule #2). Ingest adjudicates DECLARED metadata only; it never decodes. Flips to a plain boolean in v1.1 when ffprobe/MediaInfo lands (requires a runtime execution environment).

asset_manifest_id.description: Addition 5. This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7) — mirrors reel_ref.asset_manifest_id and parent_chain[6].
